title: Pitfall!
description: Guide Pitfall Harry through a jungle full of crocodiles, scorpions and rolling logs to collect treasure against a 20-minute clock.

title: Pac-Man
description: The famous maze chase ported to the 2600, where you eat dots and avoid four ghosts.

title: Space Invaders
description: Defend Earth from rows of descending aliens in the arcade hit that made the 2600 a best-seller.

title: River Raid
description: Fly a jet up a winding river, shooting enemies and refuelling to stay in the air.

title: Super Mario Bros.
description: Run and jump through the Mushroom Kingdom to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser.

title: The Legend of Zelda
description: Explore the overworld of Hyrule and clear dungeons to collect the pieces of the Triforce.

title: Mega Man 2
description: Take on eight robot masters, steal their weapons and storm Dr. Wily's fortress.

title: Metroid
description: Play as bounty hunter Samus Aran exploring the alien planet Zebes in a non-linear world.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog
description: Race through loops and slopes as Sonic to stop Dr. Robotnik from turning animals into robots.

title: Streets of Rage 2
description: Fight through city streets with a great soundtrack and fast combat, solo or with a friend.

title: Phantasy Star IV
description: A sci-fi RPG that wraps up the Phantasy Star saga with comic-style cutscenes and combo attacks.

title: Gunstar Heroes
description: A chaotic run-and-gun with weapon combinations, huge bosses and non-stop action.

title: Tetris
description: Stack falling blocks to clear lines in the puzzle game that made the Game Boy a household name.

title: Pokémon Red and Blue
description: Catch, train and trade creatures as you challenge gym leaders on the way to becoming champion.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
description: Link is stranded on Koholint Island and must wake the Wind Fish to escape.

title: Super Mario Land
description: Mario's first handheld adventure, set in Sarasaland and packed with short, quirky levels.

title: Super Mario World
description: Mario and Yoshi explore Dinosaur Land with secret exits, a cape and a huge map.

title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
description: Travel between the Light and Dark Worlds to defeat Ganon and save Hyrule.

title: Chrono Trigger
description: A time-travelling RPG with multiple endings, tech combos and a famous soundtrack.

title: Super Metroid
description: Samus returns to Zebes to recover the last Metroid in an atmospheric, exploration-focused classic.

title: Final Fantasy VII
description: Cloud and AVALANCHE fight the Shinra corporation and the villain Sephiroth in a landmark RPG.

title: Metal Gear Solid
description: Solid Snake infiltrates a nuclear weapons base in a cinematic stealth game.

title: Crash Bandicoot
description: Spin, jump and dodge through tropical islands as the PlayStation's mascot platformer.

title: Castlevania: Symphony of the Night
description: Explore Dracula's castle as Alucard in a game that defined the Metroidvania style.

title: Super Mario 64
description: Mario's leap into 3D, exploring painting worlds in Peach's castle to collect Power Stars.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: Link travels through time to stop Ganondorf in one of the most acclaimed games ever made.

title: GoldenEye 007
description: A Bond shooter with mission objectives and a famous four-player split-screen multiplayer mode.

title: Mario Kart 64
description: Race friends in 3D tracks with items, shortcuts and four-player battles.

title: Shenmue
description: Ryo Hazuki searches Yokosuka for his father's killer in an open, detailed city.

title: Jet Set Radio
description: Skate around Tokyo-to spraying graffiti in a stylish cel-shaded game with a funky soundtrack.

title: Sonic Adventure
description: Sonic's first full 3D adventure with six playable characters and a branching story.

title: Crazy Taxi
description: Pick up passengers and race through the city to get them to their destination against the clock.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
description: CJ returns to Los Santos in a huge open-world crime story spanning three cities.

title: Shadow of the Colossus
description: Hunt sixteen giant colossi across an empty land in a quiet, emotional game.

title: God of War
description: Kratos fights through Greek myth for revenge on Ares in brutal, fast-paced combat.

title: Gran Turismo 3: A-Spec
description: A realistic driving simulator with licensed cars, tuning and a long career mode.

title: Pokémon Emerald
description: Explore the Hoenn region and stop Team Magma and Team Aqua in the definitive third-generation Pokémon game.

title: Metroid Fusion
description: Samus is hunted by the X parasite aboard a research station in a tense sci-fi sequel.

title: Advance Wars
description: Command armies in turn-based tactical battles on grid maps, with colourful commanders and abilities.

title: Golden Sun
description: A puzzle-filled RPG with elemental magic called Psynergy and impressive graphics for the GBA.
